title: Email: ERP-3 field results at 08:10

fields.subject: FW: Orchard Standpipe field results 08:10
fields.note: Denise — first field results below. Outlet low, conductivity up a little, downstream normal so far. Lab samples are in. I am calling DDAGW. — Marcus

original.subject: Orchard Standpipe — ERP-3 field results
original.body:
Field tests 08:10

Standpipe outlet tap (outside fence): free chlorine 0.62 mg/L · pH 7.5 · conductivity 412 µS/cm (baseline ~380) · temp 14 °C · no odor
First hydrant downstream: free chlorine 0.95 mg/L · pH 7.6 · 384 µS/cm
Second hydrant downstream: free chlorine 1.02 mg/L · pH 7.6 · 381 µS/cm

Total coliform / E. coli and HPC in the incubator: 18–24 h.
Chemical screen bottles filled for the Ohio EPA contract laboratory: 48–72 h.

instructorNote: Something at the standpipe is consuming chlorine and raising conductivity; it has not spread far yet. Watch for an isolation recommendation and the DDAGW call.

snapshot.title: AIT-611 Chlorine Residual Drift — Lab Confirmation

fields.subject: FW: Confirmation of AIT-611 drift and field site
fields.note: The lab results from the manual grab sample taken at the outlet point (03:45 AM) confirm the residual is 0.7 mg/L. No calibration changes to AIT-611 since 07/15/2025. No control-system anomalies in the HMI or PLC logs. The drift is not due to instrument error or a system fault. A malevolent act is suspected. Recommend immediate precautionary boil-water advisory for Zone 2, Hilltop area.
